bugList.title: Scrolling the hotbar on mac behaves weirdly starting in 18w01a

When putting only one non-enchanted item in the grindstone GUI, the same item appears as the output
Zombie villagers in certain biomes don't spawn with their biome specific skins
Cartography table does not update when cloning maps
Wandering Trader and Trader Llama spawn in the void biome
Switching in smoker between "Showing all" and "Showing smokable" does not work

Players can sleep in the same beds as villagers
Food that can be planted cannot be eaten while targeting a block
Farmer doesn't look at plants when he is working
Villagers don't immediately replant crops
Bright spots underwater - ocean lighting errors
Foxes body model are 2 pixel higher when sleeping
Baby fox hitbox is shifted
Suspicious stews of saturation from shipwrecks and villagers still have a lasting effect
Baby foxes don't drop items they're holding when they die
Polar bear attack sound never changes pitch, even if the roar comes from a baby polar bear
Baby fox's head is off center
Crash while opening world / while ticking entity: "IllegalStateException: POI data mismatch: already registered at ev{x=##, y=##, z=##}"
